'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Walseth LS Careful Planning''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Walseth]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Yavin 4 Space'''. Username blank. Printed name Walseth; no first name on the sheet. Block letters. LIGHT checked. Lines 1, 2, 4, 5, and 6 are marked (Starting); the starting card is line 3. Line 6 written Woking → Wokling (V). Line 7 written Yavin 4: War Room → Yavin 4: Massassi War Room. Line 8 written Yavin 4: Throne Room → Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room. Line 15 written Chewie (V), not Chewbacca. Line 16 written Corran Hom → Corran Horn. Lines 21–24 written R2-D2 in Red 5 → Artoo-Detoo In Red 5. Line 48 written Reinforcement (singular) → Antilles Maneuver & Rebel Reinforcements (V). Line 53 written Honor of a Jedi → Honor Of The Jedi. Line 56 written Strike Force (V) → Strikeforce (V). Line 60 written without commas → Anger, Fear, Aggression (V). Shield 2 written Weapon's Display → Weapons Display. Get To Your Ships and Stay Sharp are the titles with exclamation marks. Shield 10 written Do Or Do Not → Do, Or Do Not. Shield boxes 1–12 are empty. Additional cards blank.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Careful Planning (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
